description: A sealed WebRTC session description for one tunnel; sent as the payload of a market.event. Non-trickle ICE: the requester offers once with all candidates, the guest answers once. Direction comes from the author: a requester-authored one is forwarded by the bidder to the guest's subscription; a bidder-authored one carries what the guest said. The bidder never opens the ciphertext.

kind.description: The SDP type of the sealed session description.

tag.description: Names the webrtc tunnel of the contract (spec.tunnels).

ciphertext.description: The session description, age armored ciphertext. The plaintext is the JSON object {"sdp": <session description>, "replyTo": <age recipient, offers only>}: an offer is sealed to the guest's latest compute.events.guest.publicKey for the tag and names in replyTo the age recipient the answer must be sealed to; an answer is sealed to that replyTo. No record names the key, so a reader opens every signal for the tag with its identity and keeps the ones that open.
